budget_items.topic: Average single family tax bill comparison
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The average single family tax bill in Lunenburg was reported as lower than the state average.
budget_items.quote: the average single family tax bill in lunenburg was $4,064

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $473 difference, about $40 per month, was given as the approximate cost of an override in the amount of $2,085,000.
budget_items.quote: $473, or about $40 per month, would be the approximate cost

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The override amount was printed on the forecast slide.
The forecast assumption is that recycling is fully covered for the program cost.
budget_items.quote: recycling = cover full amount of program (inc. $15.5k)

budget_items.topic: Personnel and health insurance cost assumptions
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Personnel costs were assumed to rise about 3.5% overall; health insurance and pension were assumed to rise 9 to 10 percent.
budget_items.quote: personnel costs- union & non-union- according to contract, about 3.5% overall

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion that now is the time to present an override to voters; no dollar figure was stated in that comment.
budget_items.quote: commented that now seems to be the time to present an override to the voters given the state of the town's roadways
